s.note: Soft-centred boiled eggs wrapped in parsley and mustard sausage meat, crumbed and fried golden, with English mustard
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 6 1/2 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Mix 400g pork sausage mince with 2 tbsp chopped parsley, 1 tsp mustard powder and pepper, divide into 4 and flatten each on wet hands. Wrap around the eggs and seal well. Roll in 50g plain flour, then 1 beaten egg, then 80g dry breadcrumbs, and chill for 20 minutes. Heat 1 litre of oil to 170C and fry 2 at a time for about 7 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Drain, halve and serve warm with English mustard.

s.note: Crustless white bread fingers with thin salted cucumber and lemon and dill cream cheese
s.how: Toss 1 very thinly sliced telegraph cucumber with 1/2 tsp salt and drain for 15 minutes. Beat 125g soft cream cheese with 40g soft butter, 1 tbsp chopped dill, the zest of 1 lemon and a little white pepper. Spread over 8 slices of white bread, pat the cucumber dry and layer it over 4 slices, then close. Cut off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

m.note: Thin crumbed pork schnitzel fried golden in butter, with lemon and a warm mustard and chive potato salad
m.how: Boil 800g kipfler potatoes until tender. Warm 125ml vegetable stock with 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard and 1 finely chopped small red onion, slice the potatoes hot, pour over the dressing, add 3 tbsp oil and chopped chives and season. Pound 600g pork loin steaks to 5mm between baking paper and season. Dip in 75g plain flour, 2 beaten eggs and 150g dry breadcrumbs. Fry in 150ml oil and 30g butter over medium high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve with lemon wedges and the warm potato salad.

w.note: Dark, sticky golden syrup gingerbread with ginger and cinnamon, cut in warm squares under hot vanilla custard
w.how: Heat the oven to 170C and line a 20cm square tin. Melt 125g butter, 125g brown sugar and 175g golden syrup together. Mix 250g plain flour, 2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda, then whisk in the syrup mixture, 1 egg and 200ml milk. Pour into the tin and bake for 40 minutes until risen and springy. Warm 500ml vanilla custard and serve over warm squares of the gingerbread.

d.n: Jeremy and Jemima's lemon barley water
d.note: Old-fashioned cloudy barley water with lemon zest and juice, lightly sweet and served icy with lemon slices
d.how: Rinse 100g pearl barley and simmer with 1.5 litres of water and the zest of 3 lemons for 30 minutes. Strain into a jug over 100g caster sugar and stir to dissolve, then cool and chill for 1 hour. Stir in the juice of the 3 lemons and serve over ice with lemon slices.
